verdict.rationale: Lever's documented AI features cover candidate matching (Talent Fit), interview transcripts and summaries, interview-question generation and an onboarding AI Form Builder. None of these is AI drafting of job descriptions, outreach sequences or rejection notes in the recruiter's tone. Advanced Nurture automates personalized outreach, but nothing indicates the message text is AI-generated, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
